name: genos_loop_detection_check
description: Analyzes an agent's iteration history for cognitive loops (exact signature match, state stagnation, or semantic loop).

history_file.description: Path to the JSON file containing the Vec<IterationSnapshot>.

exact_match.description: Threshold for consecutive identical tool calls.

stagnation.description: Threshold for consecutive iterations without state change.

similarity.description: Cosine similarity threshold for detecting semantic loops.
